title: Circular Entrepreneurship: From Material Loops to a Viable Venture
subject: Circular Entrepreneurship and Sustainable Strategy
description: Turn circular-economy principles into a testable venture model by mapping product life cycles, selecting value-retention strategies, designing reverse flows, and validating environmental and business assumptions.
outcomes: Map value and material flows across a product life cycle
Select an appropriate reuse, repair, remanufacturing, or recycling strategy
Design and test a circular venture model with measurable assumptions

catalogAlignment.relationship: Independent reusable companion; not an official RIT course section
